description: List calendars in the org. Org-level API keys see every calendar (agent-owned and shared); agent-scoped keys see only their own agent's calendars. Use this to discover calendar IDs before creating or listing events.

agent_id.description: Filter to calendars owned by this agent. Org keys only — agent-scoped keys are always limited to their own agent and ignore this.

include.description: Pass "all" to include calendars across all agents (org keys only)

name: list_calendars
